item.name: Get Entity Custom Links By ID

request.name: Get Entity Custom Links By ID

description.content:
This endpoint retrieves the links associated with a specific entity at the given level and ID.

Request

Path Parameters
level (string): Entity Level
- Organization: 'organizations'
- Account: 'accounts'
- Contact: 'contacts'
- Opportunity: 'opportunities'
- Risk: 'risks'
id (string): Entity ID
Should be in the format "srcid-{velarisId}" when passing internal ID or "extid-{externalId} when passing external ID.

Example:

  • With external id: /organizations/extid-id/links

  • With internal id: /organizations/srcid-id/links

Response

The response will include the list of links associated with the specified entity.

Search custom object instances using custom attributes

The request body should contain a list of filters up to 3 filters

  • filters - list of filters

    • filter - object

      • fieldName: API name of the custom attribute

      • operator: operator which should be used in the filter

      • value: filtered value

Supported Operators

Data type Operators
String equals, contains
Number equals, greaterThan, lessThan, greaterThanOrEqualTo, lessThanOrEqualTo
Date equals, after, before, onOrAfter, onOrBefore
Boolean equals
Single Picklist equals
Multi Picklist includes
Organization / Account / Contact / User equals
Organization / Account / Contact / User Picklist includes

Valid Format of the value

  • String: Value must be a non-empty string.

  • Number: Value must be a valid number (can be provided as a string).

  • Date: Value must be a date string in the format "YYYY-MM-DD".

  • Boolean: Value must be a boolean string ('true' or 'false').

  • Single Picklist, Organization, Account, Contact, User: Value must be a number.

  • Multi Picklist, Organization Picklist, Account Picklist, Contact Picklist, User Picklist: Value must be a non-empty array of numbers.
